stories.headline: Opus 5.5 price leak traces to one leaker, and Anthropic lists nothing
stories.standfirst: The claim of a Tuesday launch at $4 and $20 per million tokens reached dozens of outlets in four languages within thirty hours of a single post.
body: A claim that Anthropic will release Claude Opus 5.5 on Tuesday at prices 20 percent below the current model has spread across dozens of outlets since Sunday afternoon. The figures given are $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output, with cache reads at $0.20 and writes at $5. The model is said to be testing under the codename claude-wafer-eap.

The chain runs back to one post. The account kimmonismus wrote on Sunday that, according to a leaker called Lyra, a checkpoint for the next Opus was already available under that codename, and that release could come as early as Tuesday. Almost every later account carries the same codename and the same two prices.

The relays are not independent of it. TestingCatalog, which follows model tests closely, wrote that the rumours suggest Opus 5.5 may arrive this week, credited a summary by another account, and marked its own screenshot as illustration only. The same account had listed Opus 5.2 in testing a day earlier, alongside Sonnet 5.2 and Fable 5.2.

Anthropic's published price list carries no Opus 5.5. It shows Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output, with cache reads at $0.50 and writes at $6.25. The leaked pair sits exactly 20 percent below both. The company's account has announced no model since Thursday, when it named Accenture as an evaluation partner.

Something does appear to be coming. Reuters reported on Friday that Anthropic is weighing a new model to answer GPT-6 Astra, days after Dario Amodei urged the industry to slow down. Polymarket put the next Opus at 72 percent to arrive by Thursday. None of that confirms a name, a price or a date.

Kimmonismus said on Monday that he cannot confirm any of it. No model card, API identifier or benchmark has appeared. One version of the rumour has the context window falling from 936,000 tokens to 872,000, a detail most retellings leave out. A published price list on Tuesday would settle it either way.

sources.author: OrcaRouter — analysis of the leak's sourcing
